But also typical farm animals like sheep, cows and pigs enrich your farm and make it an attraction with a high leisure value.

name: Alum
shortDescription: Guide Alum on his journey through the "Land of Tide". Help him discover the truth about his city, Kosmos, and the mysterious epidemic known as "The Vague". As the tale unfolds, it will keep you enthralled all the way up to its epic conclusion. Alum is an original point-and-click adventure game.

name: Terra Lander Remastered
shortDescription: Navigate the player to the landing pad through twenty increasingly difficult levels within the time limit and with enough fuel.

name: The Race for the White House
shortDescription: Play as a real-world candidate and completely immerse yourself into the battle of the US presidential election! Travel around the United States, try to woo voters across the country, create your own political agenda, skillfully manage your campaign budget... and perhaps you will be the next White House occupant!

name: Wildlife Camp
shortDescription: Discover new animal species, nurse them back to health and care for them. Look after your little camp with its cute and extraordinary residents. Enjoy some breathtaking encounters with exotic animals, and experience direct contact with the animals and their environment.

name: Subsiege
shortDescription: Subsiege is an intense real-time tactic game with focus on massive 12 player battles. In a grasping deep sea world, you command a hand-picked squad of hero-like units to contend merciless sea monsters and fierce competitors while your oxygen runs out with every breath. Can you stand the pressure?

name: Urja
shortDescription: The king is deceitful, the queen is wicked, and the bishop unholy. In every land it’s the same. Corrupted knights and power hungry pawns. It’s time for change. You've waited long enough. Be brave. Be daring. Be the last one standing.

name: Death Ray Manta SE
shortDescription: Death Ray Manta is an arcade game where you shoot lasers to kill bad guys, flash lights at yourself and move to the next screen to do it all over again. Sorry, no T-Rex.

name: Demise of Nations
shortDescription: Demise of Nations is a 4X turn-based grand strategy wargame covering the rise of Rome till the fall of modern civilization.

name: Retro Commander
shortDescription: Retro Commander is a post-apocalyptic real-time strategy wargame (RTS).

name: Star Nomad
shortDescription: Explore, trade, fight & plunder in this tribute to classic sandbox spacesims of old.

name: Harold
shortDescription: As the guardian angel-in-training assigned to watch over Harold, you’re going to need a miracle to get him safely through a series of increasingly challenging obstacle courses in one piece. Shoot lightning, delay the other racers and move heaven and earth to give Harold the boost he needs to win!

name: Ukrainian Ninja
shortDescription: Ukrainian Ninja is a multiplayer platformer game for Windows. The Ninja shoots and slashes, using weapons sold by the trader to clear each world.

name: Pig Eat Ball
shortDescription: Pig Eat Ball is a top-down, action-adventure about eating, getting fat, and barfing on things to solve levels. Explore 20 giant space stations to find different Disguises, and using their Pros and Cons, fight and solve your way through over 200 action-puzzle levels using new, arcade-style mechanics.

name: Fork Parker's Holiday Profit Hike
shortDescription: Against explosive firepower, bitter cold, and dizzying heights, Fork Parker must outwit a group of no-talent game developers in a deadly holiday promotional game. Also, it's free.

name: Tales of the Orient: The Rising Sun
shortDescription: Dive into an epic story of honor and courage and help a Geisha and a Samurai save the day.

name: Winged Sakura: Endless Dream
shortDescription: Discover. Build. Defend. Survive. Escort. Open endless doors, discover endless new rooms, and defeat endless robots. Build towers, form contracts, gain new allies, and survive the Endless Dream.

name: Snake Blocks
shortDescription: Snake blocks is a colorful 3D puzzle game from Spooky Cat Games. Join the five friendly snakes as you push, pull, and twist them through dozens of challenging puzzle scenarios. Mind-bending puzzles and beautiful design come together in Snake Blocks!

name: A Pixel Story
shortDescription: A Pixel Story is a devious 2D puzzle platformer that charts the evolution of video games. You must use your Magical Teleportation Hat to explore 6 increasingly detailed zones on your quest to reach the core of The System to stop the evil OS and save the world.

name: Blasted Fortress
shortDescription: Use voodoo magic and a big cannon to crush fortresses. It's a blend of physics decimation, hoarding resources, and RPG style enhancements.

name: Man Alive
shortDescription: Man Alive is a platform game with a twist (or two). We are working with the idea that death is not the end. There are no health packs, because we promote death in Man Alive!

name: Crowman & Wolfboy
shortDescription: Crowman & Wolfboy is a story driven, level based, action-platformer/runner hybrid. Join this unlikely pair of shadow creatures on a bizarre journey to escape their own nature and find the mysterious beings known as "humans".

name: Paperbound
shortDescription: Run with scissors and walk on walls in this award-winning local-multiplayer gravity battle arena game from the mind of a former Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare developer. Enter the pages of old books where you will find strange environments and a cabal of playable characters.

name: Cyber Chicken
shortDescription: Cyber Chicken is 2.5D adventure featuring 8', 375 pounds of cybernetic poultry as a futuristic killing machine on a quixotic mission to save the World. The game features fun combat, classic platforming, outrageous humor, rocking soundtrack and a fully upgradeable Cyber Chicken arsenal.

name: Debugger 3.16: Hack'n'Run
shortDescription: Help Debugger 3.16 to find and delete all bugs in the game worlds of the developer. Learn and use program code in this award-winning puzzle platformer to program you very own game at the end!

name: SuiCats
shortDescription: SuiCats is an engaging puzzle game where you combine kittens to create amazing cat cascades. Diverse physics and a humorous design will keep you smiling while playing SuiCats. Join the feline adventure and break the high score today!

name: Starwalker
shortDescription: Starwalker is a space-exploration survival rpg focused on surviving a massive alien invasion on planet Earth. You'll be able to explore the solar system and beyond. You are the last human standing - ready to start a new life.

name: The Moment of Silence
shortDescription: The Moment of Silence is a classic point-and-click 3rd person adventure game set in New York City in 2044. Players step into the role of Peter Wright, an advertising executive currently heading up the Government's 'Freedom of Speech' campaign.

name: NoseBound
shortDescription: A classic Point & Click adventure set in a stylized Noir world. What starts as a routine detective case quickly spirals into a Lovecraftian nightmare. Interrogate suspects, deduce the truth, and uncover secrets that were better left buried.

name: Dungeon of gain
shortDescription: Many inhabitants wishing to get the tribute came back to the city. Only the time will show whether the main character will find the riches or he is fated to decorate one of the undercroft corners with his skeleton.

name: Night Crisis
shortDescription: Night Crisis is based upon a multiplayer co-op experience. There will be multiple factions of enemies to take down, which may have units on the ground, in the air and on sea.

name: Bloop
shortDescription: Ignite your imagination with a whimsical 2D liquid physics-based puzzle game by Studio 2SD!

name: Predestination
shortDescription: Predestination is a turn-based sci-fi 4X game set in the distant past of our own galaxy. Ships from countless races are flung back in time by a powerful hostile race known as the Revenants, and must now work to rebuild their empires and somehow stop the Revenants in the past.

name: Crystal Towers 2 XL
shortDescription: Jump and blast your way through the hostile reaches of the kingdom on your quest to recover the Music Crystals!

name: Deity Quest
shortDescription: Deity Quest is a light-hearted RPG where your goal is to convert followers and gain power to become the Overgod of Aberos. Use your divine magic to support your followers in fast-paced, strategic 6 vs. 6 battles, and compete with other deities in your quest to reach the top!

name: Quintet
shortDescription: A cooperative, cross-platform, multiplayer scifi game where players control the same ship through 5 roles — Captain, Helm, Tactical, Engineering & Science. Battle with other player crews over the Internet.

name: Lucid Awakening 2
shortDescription: Play through an engaging and emotional story set in a deep world full of its own original mythology and history. Take advantage of the Dual Soul class system, switching between Pure and Veil classes in the heat of battle, to conquer challenging enemies and bosses.

name: SuperBike TT
shortDescription: SuperBike TT is a single-player, physics-based racing game within a multi-team and multi-bike livery for built-in replayability.

name: Grand Class Melee 2
shortDescription: GCM2 is fierce arena combat with an RPG job system for 1-4 players. Battle to the top of the class tree and get massively powered-up!

name: Crashed Lander
shortDescription: Outwit gravity, race the clock, explore new worlds.Crashed lander is a gravity-based arcade game inspired by classics like Lunar Lander and Space Taxi. You'll pilot your craft from pad to pad trying to beat your best time – then flirt with that fine line between speed and control.

name: Spartans Vs Zombies Defense
shortDescription: In this tug-of-war, casual defense game， you play Leonidas who is the hero-king of Sparta, against hordes of attacking zombies in Thermopylae. Recruit allies and build defenses to stop them!

name: You Are Not a Banana: Better Edition
shortDescription: You Are Not a Banana is set in everyday life and has a sprinkle of imagination and humor. The audiovisuals (free OST included) seek to evoke nostalgia for the 80s and 90s. This short form experimental game unfolds as a sequence of thought provoking events and surprises.

name: Project Green Beat
shortDescription: Inspired by the demoscene, each of Project Green Beat’s unique levels merge stunning visuals with high energy rhythms to create a truly unique music-based rail shooter. It is a fully immersive experience where the music inspires the visuals and drives the flow of motion.

name: The Warriorlock
shortDescription: The Warriorlock is a story-driven adventure RPG, with plenty of dialogue, humor and deadly miles of classic turn-based grinding. Are you hard enough?

name: Crunch Time!
shortDescription: Crunch Time! is a fresh and innovative card game with a touch of humour, based on videogame development, in which you'll have to manage your own company, and complete the best and biggest projects before your opponent.

name: Wanted Corp.
shortDescription: Wanted Corp is a top-down action game in which you play as two intergalactic bounty hunters with different powers. Play solo or with a friend, locally or on-line and team up to survive! The hunt is on!

name: WolfWars
shortDescription: WolfWars is a fantasy tactical strategy card game that you will be able to build or edit your decks with available cards and heroes.

name: The Depths of Tolagal
shortDescription: The Depths of Tolagal is an addictive roguelike dungeon crawler with an emphasis on tactical combat.

name: Bunny Bash
shortDescription: Meat grind your way through an online multi­-player death match...with bunnies. Pick your bunny and enter levels of bunny blitzing mayhem. Take on your friends or meet new people while you smash and stomp them into bloody bunny goo; bouncing your way to bunny bashing victory.

name: Aqua Panic !
shortDescription: After a violent tropical cyclone, the fish, shrimp, octopuses and other sea creatures find themselves flung out of the water… There's not a minute to lose! Use original tools to guide them to freedom! You'll need to think hard and act fast to save them all!

name: The Tiny Tale 2
shortDescription: The Elven kingdom is in great danger! Thanks to the greed of Elven Queen Ginevra the Elven life-giving shrine was corrupted by the Evil Necromancer. The Troll and his fellow Gremlins must find the remaining holy shrines scattered around the kingdom to heal the cursed one and banish the Necromancer.

name: Gunslugs 2
shortDescription: The Black Duck Army is back—bigger, badder, and armed with alien tech! In Gunslugs 2, chaos reigns as you blast through tanks, choppers, giant robots, and hordes of relentless minions. This action-packed, over-the-top run-and-gun adventure is a wild tribute to classic 80s and 90s action movies.

name: Deepworld
shortDescription: Deepworld is a massively-multiplayer 2D crafting adventure game. Mine and craft your way through a persistent online universe where there's always something new to discover. Battle frightening monsters, mysterious automatons, and other players in PvP!

name: Solar War
shortDescription: A turn-based grand strategy game in space, set in the near future: Defend Earth against an alien invasion from the edge of the Solar System and expand your campaign to push them back to their base.

name: Siege of Turtle Enclave
shortDescription: A turn based strategy game with real time battles! Build up your settlement, train mighty armies, research technologies, cast spells, discover hidden goodies and more as you fight your way across the map to overthrow the enemy warlord in his keep!

name: Let There Be Life
shortDescription: Let There Be Life is an award-winning relaxing and creative experience that allows you to build trees and play with wildlife...just don't put too much shadow on the plants below!

name: Pulsen
shortDescription: Pulsen is a music and rhythm game where you listen to music and move along to the beat. Can you master your timing and groove through the expansive song list and challenging patterns? Hit arrows to the beat of the music, the better your accuracy the better your score!

name: The Lady
shortDescription: "The Lady" is a 2D Surreal Puzzle Horror, featuring hand drawn character art, stop motion animation, and a hauntingly abrasive Noisecore Soundtrack. The game features the most unique female protagonist to ever exist in a video game.

name: Stay Dead Evolution
shortDescription: Be an action B-movie hero and defeat all your enemies in this intense fighting experience! Stay Dead Evolution is a unique arcade action game based on real life footage.

name: NeXus: One Core
shortDescription: Use fusion. Avoid obstacles. Die. Try again.

name: On A Roll 3D
shortDescription: On A Roll 3D is a fast, colourful 3D platform game. Roll your way through 24 huge levels across six different themes and be prepared to take on spikes, mines, dynamite, conveyor belts, springs, switches, doors, bumpers, lasers, saws, fire, ice, water, electricity, trapdoors and much much more.

name: Steam Heroes
shortDescription: Help three brave adventurers on their quest to stop the diabolical Baron Von Smog’s plot to conquer Steam Land. However, there is an army of evil minions that stand in your way. Challenge yourself in this new puzzle strategy game; includes 12 action-packed stages, a full soundtrack, competitive online play, all in stunning 720p HD...

name: Isaac the Adventurer
shortDescription: Embark on a dangerous journey in the role of a small boy who is chasing his dream of becoming a great adventurer.

name: Samphi
shortDescription: Samphi is a fresh, randomly-generated, survival-RPG with a shifted focus to skills, world management, and a story mode*. Travel through broken memories of a failing relationship to try and salvage what’s left. How you play is up to you. The world is yours. Your story is waiting.

name: Lazors
shortDescription: Lazors is a puzzle game of lasers and mirrors offering more than 200 levels, ranging from easy distractions to hard challenges.

name: Countless Rooms of Death
shortDescription: Countless Rooms of Death is a puzzle / adventure game with a horror atmosphere. There are no weapons or real enemies; instead, we aim to bully your mind. All you, the player, have is a flashlight with which to find your way through a dark labyrinth, solving puzzles to acquire keys which will allow you to enter the next level.

name: BANZAI PECAN: The Last Hope For the Young Century
shortDescription: REGAIN JUSTICE! Use the divine art BANZAI SHINKEN to restore justice in this old-school arcade-style hard-knuckle brawler!

name: Loot Hunter
shortDescription: Loot Hunter is a fun role-play game from the world full of old ships, pirates and adventures!

name: Crayon Chronicles
shortDescription: Crayon Chronicles is a:Single-playerTurn-basedRPGRoguelike...offering a relatively short (2-4 hours per play-through) but action-packed experience that randomly generates the level layouts each time you play.

name: Stardust Vanguards
shortDescription: STARDUST VANGUARDS is a local four-player dueling game combining arcade-style battling with the ability to summon your own NPC army as support! But be careful: a random event system dynamically alters the flow of battle with NPC space pirates gunning for victory themselves!

name: TRIP Steam Edition
shortDescription: Explore an avant-garde cubist dream, stimulate your visual senses and immerse yourself in a surreal TRIP. A visually tantalizing open world artware that culminates the player to relax and enjoy a safe enviroment for them to explore at their own pace. There are no objectives, no rules, just art.

name: Throbax TD
shortDescription: Throbax TD is the "Tower Defense" game you are looking for: Help Ughlar fight his way through 50 levels, buy over 100 upgrades and get all of the 50+ achievements.

name: Relativity Wars - A Science Space RTS
shortDescription: Relativity Wars is a god-type strategy/action game, set in a universe which obeys Einstein’s theories of relativity!

name: Barren Roads
shortDescription: Nuclear weapons have the left the world barren and scorched the earth. Survival has never been harder for mankind. Resources are scarce as life has left this world. You are forced to constantly move and scavenge the next area for resources. Rivers are dry. Many of wanderers never survived the icy nights as the moon crosses the sky.

name: stratO
shortDescription: Glide, swoop, tuck, dive, magnetize, grind, walldrive, and burn your way through rings to advance the difficulty of the vast, procedurally-generated environment while avoiding the fog and getting stranded! This game demands a great deal of skill and is not suited for casual players or people susceptible to motion sickness.

name: The Great Fusion
shortDescription: Finally comes to Steam the funniest graphic adventure game from Android and iOS. Featured by Google twice, with more than 100,000 downloads and thousands of positive reviews, The Great Fusion is back remastered with full HD graphics and redesigned comics.

name: Cahors Sunset
shortDescription: Cahors Sunset is a light-RPG in which you control the decisions of an old French man. Your goal is try to keep the main character alive for as long as you can through the decisions you make each month. Every action have wanted and unwanted effects on your character's health.

name: Among Ripples
shortDescription: Control a pond's ecosystem; experiment with what you can do and see what happens. Among Ripples is a meditative ecosystem management simulator; you add different creatures to the pond and see how they interact.

name: A.V.
shortDescription: A.V. is a first-person stealth-puzzle-musical-adventure game (Try saying that 5 times fast). The game places the player in the role of a rogue music-processing algorithm from a computer's sound systems. From this role, the player can view the world only through audible means.

name: Flem
shortDescription: Try, die, cry, repeat. Flem is an old school hard-as-nails platformer about a sentient snot ball, with a nose-stalgia inducing soundtrack.

name: Geared
shortDescription: Geared is a highly addictive, physics-based spatial puzzler. Goal: Power the blue gears.

name: Plush
shortDescription: Plush combines stuffed animal simulation with the imagination of a little girl to provide a unique puzzle experience. To successfully complete each level, the player must arrange the stuffed animals in such a way as to make them all "happy" before bedtime.

name: HitBox
shortDescription: HitBox is a fast paced, competitive multiplayer shooter. A minimalist and colorful style enables high frame rates and fluid gameplay. Play local or online multiplayer with up to 4 players in splitscreen!

name: Ultimate Space Commando
shortDescription: USC is a turn-based, top-down view tactics game in which you control the crew of a stranded recon vessel in a "first contact war" for survival, featuring a detailed combat system with RPG elements, fully interactive randomized maps, unique weapons and gadgets, crafting, and custom multiplayer modes.

name: BiT Evolution
shortDescription: Evolve through the history of video games in this fun-filled blast from the past.

name: Rogue Invader
shortDescription: 1-Bit Roguelite Action Shooter.

name: The Clans - Saga of the Twins
shortDescription: Experience a point-and-click adventure RPG game like never before featuring seven playable female characters and a male vampire in this not-so serious tale. Catz and Kitsune desire to go on an adventure with Xenonight who have no choice but to follow them.

name: Sym
shortDescription: Sym is a puzzle-platformer that explores social anxiety disorder. Play as Josh, a teenage boy trying to reconcile a maze of two contrasting worlds that coexist within the blank spaces of each other - his perception of reality, and the world he created to avoid his fears.

name: Air Guardians
shortDescription: Air Guardians is a flight combat game set in the distant future. A world government is attempting to seal their grip on power, and an air force of advanced fighter craft is called upon to fight them. Fly through several different levels, with cut scenes between missions and in game narration.

name: SCHAR: Blue Shield Alliance
shortDescription: SCHAR: Blue Shield Alliance is a cooperative twin-stick shooter that features a variety of complementing ship classes to choose from. Upgrade your ships, defeat hundreds of enemies, save the galaxy all with some friends from the comfort of your couch.

name: Aspectus: Rinascimento Chronicles
shortDescription: Netherlands, 1520. The Destroyers of the Art come out of paintings and materialize from statues, they come to infect the Art and wreck the city. To trap them, help Mr. Bruesen create the Aspectus, the Perfect Painting, before the time runs out. Find the sect of the amorphous creatures and destroy it.

name: Train of Afterlife
shortDescription: Train of Afterlife is a mystery, psychological, horror Visual Novel.

name: Gunscape
shortDescription: Gunscape provides easy-to-use tools based on a block-placement interface everybody's already familiar with to create all types of maps. Don't like building stuff? Then just blast your way through hordes of monsters or duel with other players!

name: Human Extinction Simulator
shortDescription: Tactical turn-based space battles. Elaborate war strategies to prepare against the inevitable alien invasion.

name: Bret Airborne
shortDescription: Bret Airborne shakes up the standard match-3 formula with strategic gameplay and original game mechanics.

name: BoxesWithGuns
shortDescription: BoxesWithGuns is a 2D neon vertex endless shooter game. Try to survive as long as possible by avoiding collisions with the enemies that spawn. One game equals the length of the background music track playing. Collect dollars and customize your spaceship by adding new boxes and weapons.

name: Heroes Never Lose: Professor Puzzler's Perplexing Ploy
shortDescription: Heroes Never Lose: Professor Puzzler's Perplexing Ploy is a hero-themed action puzzler with a super-powered twist!

name: Terminal Hacker - Into the Deep
shortDescription: Your sister Merle McPenrite has dropped off the grid without notice. Reports indicate that this is a fate she shares with countless others.

name: Witch's Pranks: Frog's Fortune Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Evil witch decided to marry a prince. And everyone, who rejected her, she turned to frogs. Help bewitched princes to reach their brides to cure the spell with a kiss of love.

name: Fermi's Path
shortDescription: As a subatomic particle you start a journey into subatomic space! This arcade title takes you to the limits of your reaction speed - and with the powerful level editor you can create even harder challenges!

name: Brawlerz Arena
shortDescription: Cars, guns & multiplayer mayhem! Play with insane vehicles with machine guns, railguns, rocket launchers and flamethrowers & compete in deathmatch, soccer and capture the flag game modes!

name: Corona MotorSport
shortDescription: Corona MotorSport is back and better than ever! Rebuilt from the ground up, Corona MotorSport now features beautiful graphics, realistic simulation-based physics and challenging AI to race against!

name: Synonymy
shortDescription: Synonymy is a non-profit, educational word game narrated by Richard Dawkins where players are challenged to find a path between random words through their network of synonyms. By taking the synonym of a word, and then a synonym of that synonym, and so on, you can ultimately arrive at any other word in a language.

name: Vantage: Primitive Survival Game
shortDescription: Vantage is a passion project created by a solo developer where your main objective is simple... to stay alive! You explore the massive world searching for food, creating primitive tools and weapons to hunt, and craft other items to make life easier. Play Online/Offline Multiplayer or Single Player.

name: Toto Temple Deluxe
shortDescription: Toto Temple Deluxe is a fast-paced, local-multiplayer king-of-the-hill style game in which players must steal an egg-laying goat from their friends and try to keep it on their own head for as long as possible. You know, normal stuff.

name: Destination Sol
shortDescription: Pilot your ship in the seamless open world made of space, planets, and more. Find new ships and equipment, find allies and beat all the enemies in this open source space shooter!

name: MagNets
shortDescription: MagNets: an intense arcade-style robot-recycling collect-em-up! Players must fight to restore order in Polarity City, one arena at a time. Do this by capturing malfunctioning Bloxbots in your Electromagnetic Nets, or use your MagNet to fight against a friend!

name: Motorbike
shortDescription: A casual bike skills game full of action and real physics dynamics.

name: Reef Defense
shortDescription: Reef Defense is a fast-paced, intense strategy game where relentless waves of crustaceans are coming for your precious eggs! Arm your reef with strategically positioned defenses and hold the line. Can you outlast the swarm, or will your eggs become crab food?

name: Cyberpunk 3776
shortDescription: Cyberpunk 3776 harkens back to the glory days of arcade shoot-em-ups. It all begins on a postapocalyptic earth and proceeds into space. Your journey will be a metaphor about life and death, a road that every person has to walk down alone. The only choices you get while on your path to the inevitable end: keep your head up high or forfeit.

name: Top Trumps Turbo
shortDescription: Top Trumps™ Turbo is a brand new, exclusive fun and exciting Top Trumps™ card game brought to you by Funbox Media. Use the cards and your skills to beat the computer and become the ultimate Top Trumps™ Turbo Champion!

name: Gene
shortDescription: Gene is an awesome, fun, well designed platformer. With a huge creative environment to explore, you must run, jump and blast your way through. Featuring high scores, pesky enemies to defeat, free play mode and mutations to collect. It’s hours of fun.

name: Zotrix
shortDescription: Zotrix is a modern take on the classic arcade shooter. The game introduces resource trading economy and system of upgrades between number of space stations bringing the classic experience into modern generation. Aliens are attacking and Solar Division Command needs You!

name: StaudSoft's Synthetic World Beta
shortDescription: Welcome to StaudSoft's Synthetic World! It allows you via a seed to create a unique landscape with mountains, oceans, trees and beaches. Although it looks like a normal game engine, everything in the game is based on voxels. So everything you see can be changed.

name: Tiamat X
shortDescription: Featuring six levels of intense shooting action, Tiamat X is a rip-snortin tribute to the side-scrolling space shooters of yesteryear, and would be right at home blazing away on the screen of a booming, beer-stained arcade cabinet.

name: Elementary My Dear Majesty!
shortDescription: The king's daughter has turned into a man-eating monster, and either you find the cure, or it's off with your head!

name: inSynch
shortDescription: An art-music-arcade game, inSynch is handcrafted and animated in stop motion. The game jumps and hops between meditative compositions and devilishly hard time-attack challenges!

name: Hypnosis
shortDescription: Hypnotize characters, discover their inner worlds, fight phobias, regain your true love and save the humanity.

name: Rainbow Hero
shortDescription: Rainbow Hero is an old-school puzzle game set in beautiful painterly worlds. Travel on multi-directional platforms, reflect the lasers off walls, control two characters simultaneously, teleport characters and their items and a lot more.

name: CroNix
shortDescription: CroNix is a fast-paced, action-packed multiplayer PvP game set in battlefields of a post-apocalypse world.

name: InMind VR
shortDescription: Shrink down for a brief, free arcade journey inside the human brain. Follow a guided route through glowing neural landscapes, aim with your gaze, and clear targets to improve your score. Play in VR or on a regular screen.

name: Rotieer
shortDescription: Rotieer, move through the Level, rotate it and see it completly from the first second on!Solve Puzzles, find keys for locked Doors, move through Portals, ride Elevators and more...

name: Shadowgate: MacVenture Series
shortDescription: Relive the original MacVenture Series version of Shadowgate! Play through the Mac and Apple IIGS versions to experience where the franchise began.

name: The Uninvited: MacVenture Series
shortDescription: Relive the original MacVenture Series version of The Uninvited! Play through the Mac and Apple IIGS versions and survive the supernatural dangers of the haunted mansion.

name: Déjà Vu: MacVenture Series
shortDescription: Relive the original MacVenture Series version of Déjà Vu! Play through the Mac and Apple IIGS versions and discover a classic detective mystery adventure.

name: Déjà Vu II: MacVenture Series
shortDescription: Relive the original MacVenture Series version of Déjà Vu II! Play through the Mac and Apple IIGS versions as a hard-boiled detective in a city full of crime and mystery.

name: Trash TV
shortDescription: Welcome to the world of Trash TV. Cast away into a recycling center, you play an outdated tube television animated to life with a singular goal – find your remote control and become fully functional again.

name: Ghost Pirates of Vooju Island
shortDescription: Mysterious Things are Happening on Vooju Island...

name: Never Ending Night
shortDescription: Never Ending Night is a 2D side-scrolling exploration game. As the Player, you roam through a mysterious world you have no recollection of. Traverse through a broken world and survive through the mechanical monstrosities that have managed to survive the calamity...

name: Cataegis : The White Wind
shortDescription: Welcome to Cataegis - The White Wind: Ziggurat Chapter, a frantic 2D arcade action retro-style game that pays homage to the glory days of 8-bit side scrolling gaming.

name: World of Cinema - Movie Tycoon
shortDescription: 1 – 4 players manage a film studio and compete in a thrilling challenge for fame, money and awards. Each player starts as head of a small film studio with small budget.

name: Immortal Empire
shortDescription: Immortal Empire is a multiplayer tactics role playing game. Control a party of up to 5 immortals as you travel through a unique fantasy world, using spells and strategy to defeat your enemies. Play co-op, versus, or solo through a compelling campaign storyline with fully voiced characters.

name: Janky Tanks
shortDescription: Janky Tanks is a local multiplayer combat game for 1-8 players. It features hilarious physics and rapid "janky" combat. Seriously, your tank winds up spending most of its time in the air, using wall jumps and rocket jumps to fight. It's fun for the whole family. Try it. You won't be disappoint.

name: Pixel Puzzles 2: Birds
shortDescription: Pixel Puzzles 2: Birds is a traditional style jigsaw puzzle game, with crabs scurrying around so WATCH YOUR FINGERS!!!

name: InnerCube
shortDescription: InnerCube is an action-puzzle game, where you control a multi-colored cube using the keyboard to navigate around a grid. Choose from two different modes: a challenging Puzzle Mode where every move counts or a fast and frantic Survival Mode!Unleash your Inner Cube!

name: Heckabomb
shortDescription: Explosive twin stick shooter. Lots of upgrades. Full controller support. Awesome soundtrack.

name: Three Fourths Home: Extended Edition
shortDescription: A visual short story set in Nebraska, Three Fourths Home follows an extended conversation between Kelly and her family during a drive home through an intense thunderstorm.

name: World of Mixed Martial Arts 3
shortDescription: Step into the world of MMA in World of Mixed Martial Arts 3. In this simulation title, you control every aspect of the MMA world. Take control of an MMA company and run it the way you want. Decide who to hire, what matches will take place, and who doesn't make the cut!

name: Total Extreme Wrestling 2010
shortDescription: Step into the world of wrestling in World Total Extreme Wrestling 2010. In this simulation title, you play the role of a wrestling promoter, and it is up to you to steer your company to the top of the industry!

name: A.R.M. PLANETARY PROSPECTORS EP1 Asteroid Resource Mining
shortDescription: An expedition finds an artifact in an asteroid, teleporting the crew to an alien realm. Enslaved on a mining barge, they wield mech suits to survive, scavenging and scheming to escape—and wield the device that could rewrite Earth’s fate.

name: Undeadz!
shortDescription: Undeadz! is an open world Zombie Survival game with a retro art style!

name: Feeble Origins: Path of a Hero
shortDescription: A classic fantasy adventure set in a hand-crafted, small open world. With grandpa’s old blade, you'll go on quests to secure the forest, hunt for upgrades in caves, and delve into old tombs as you uncover the plot threatening the village. Rise to become the hero the town never expected to show up.

name: 3d Engineers
shortDescription: 3d Engineers is a sandbox game/tool in engineering and construction.

name: Dark Matter
shortDescription: Dark Matter is a classic arcade space shooter inspired by Asteroids, featuring fast-paced ship combat, physics-based movement, and score-driven gameplay.

name: Crystal Rift
shortDescription: A grid-based dungeon-crawler, in classic first person perspective.An experiential horror challenge game that takes the player through a series of increasingly mysterious locations. Comes with Full Dungeon Editor. Designed with full Virtual Reality support for the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift.

name: Agent Awesome
shortDescription: Agent Awesome is a humorous strategy game in which you will have to help Agent A plan the perfect strategy to take down E.V.I.L., all of this in order to win a drunk dare. Awesome, right?

name: Lost in a Forest
shortDescription: This game is a parody of horror games, rather than running and hiding from the monster you are now able to fight back!

name: The Quivering
shortDescription: Classic Retro point and click adventure from yesteryear. Set in the dark and foreboding village of Warty Hollow, The Quivering follows the fortunes of young Spud, as he tries to save his uncle, Olivetti Franken-Stamp, from the diabolical spell cast upon him by the big cheese from Hell, Big D.

name: The Grave Digger
shortDescription: Take control of shovel-master Fagus in this curious blend of whimsical English comedy and grim Dickensian horror.

name: War of Omens Card Game
shortDescription: War of Omens is a CCG with a unique Deckbuilder combat system and deep strategy. Set in a masterfully crafted dark fantasy world, it features fast, strategic battles with 4 distinct factions and over 20 heroes. Challenge the online ladder, conquer the story mode, or compete in a cross faction draft!

name: Lumo
shortDescription: Witness the rebirth of a genre in Lumo – a classic isometric adventure with a modern twist for gamers young and old alike!

name: Universal Combat CE
shortDescription: The ultimate space capital ship combat compendium is the evolution of hard core space combat sims. The only game of its kind currently in existence.

name: Without Within
shortDescription: The (mis)adventures of Vinty, a nobody who thinks she's somebody!

name: Crash Dummy
shortDescription: A challenging 2D platformer with numerous and pure mechanics to keep you interested throughout its unique adventure. Blast, burn, freeze your way through a story-driven adventure with a unique set of endearing characters. Jump long distances and do wall-runs for some stylish ninja action.

name: Echo Tokyo: An Intro
shortDescription: An Interactive graphic novel and a Kinetic Graphic novel to enjoy, Set within a cyber punk dystopian future. With full professional voice acting for every line and steam achievements.

name: ABRACA - Imagic Games
shortDescription: Imagi is the country where fairy tale characters live, with its bad guys and damsels in distress. So much so that becoming prince charming is a treacherous path where the gloves really come off! Two, three or four players all pretend to be princes who must survive a series of challenges!

name: Astro Emporia
shortDescription: Astro Emporia is a CASUAL turn based randomised trading game where your objective is to make as much money in a limited amount of turns.

name: I Can't Escape: Darkness
shortDescription: I Can't Escape: Darkness is a quicksand trap for the senses - the more you listen and look for clues, the deeper you fall into a damp, living dungeon. Plunge into the depths and scrape together whatever tools you can find, then try to escape one of the most diabolical puzzles of all time!

name: Boring Man - Online Tactical Stickman Combat
shortDescription: Battle other 2D stickfigures online while jumping around like a lunatic and getting blown up into smithereens. With over 70 weapons, Boring Man is the most chaotic and hilarious 2D online shooter on the internet.

name: Rktcr
shortDescription: Rktcr is tool-assisted-speed-run: the game.It both requires and enables you to play perfectly.It is a very difficult game.

name: Barter Empire
shortDescription: Classic RPG gameplay with a massive open world! Build your empire by buying land deeds, farming and questing. Go on dates, get married and adopt children. Cooking, crafting, fishing, alchemy, bartering, hunting, farming and trade systems.

name: Drew and the Floating Labyrinth
shortDescription: "I just want to go home..." A hand-drawn 3D puzzle-platformer. Control Drew find her way back home, through a series of abstract levels requiring you to find invisible paths, gaining color to her black-and-white character as you progress. Featuring unrestricted 2D animation in a 3D environment.

name: Garden Rescue
shortDescription: Help the plants to defend the garden from being invaded by sneaky beetles.

name: Ski Park Tycoon
shortDescription: Designed as a classic tycoon game, Ski Park Tycoon is a ski resort simulation PC game that will put your strategic thinking skills and creativity to the test.

name: The Old Tree
shortDescription: The Old Tree is a short free-to-play cinematic puzzle game about a newborn alien baby. Witness this microscopic entity's first moments of life and help it emerge from its underground lair and ascend towards an unknown destination.

name: BrainBread 2
shortDescription: Grab a weapon, demolish your enemies, level up, become more powerful, let the gore flow, let the limbs fly. BrainBread 2 introduces a zombie fps mixed with RPG / Arcade elements, the game is very action-packed and generally fast-paced.

name: Gran Vitreous
shortDescription: Gran Vitreous is a PC shmup that combines classic arena shooter gameplay with the mechanics of a loot driven action RPG. Upgrade your ships equipment and level up as you battle through a galaxy filled with randomly generated encounters.

name: Spectrum: First Light
shortDescription: It's the comic book platformer you have been waiting for! Phase between colors to solve puzzles and uncover the story of Tadashi and Saki. Inspired by the classic game Comix Zone™.

name: Musclecar Online
shortDescription: Online top-down racing game with a new player-designed racetrack every day. Design your own tracks and race against the ghost recordings of thousands of players around the world. Includes daily and monthly championships, achievements, and leaderboards.

name: samurai_jazz
shortDescription: An action/adventure game taking ques from both film-noir and samurai-drama's of old, "samurai_jazz" takes players on an adventure through an enigmatic city, engaging in sword-fights, encounters with mythological beings, and quirky dialog with the local inhabitants presented with a pseudo 8-bit style.

name: Toy Wars Invasion
shortDescription: The neglected and despised toys of the world are angry and have escaped their forgotten toy box prisons and are seeking revenge. Fight 21 enemy from the beach to the model train store with an arsenal of 13 weapons and armed vehicles.

name: Cylne
shortDescription: Cylne is a first person surreal exploration game having a poetic and philosophical side. Explore and feel unreal worlds filled with environmental enigmas to try to achieve the chapter called "The Choice"...

name: Decisive Campaigns: Case Blue
shortDescription: Decisive Campaigns: Case Blue simulates the German drive to Stalingrad and into the Caucasus of the summer of 1942, as well as its May preludes (2nd Kharkov offensive, Operation Trappenjagd) and also the Soviet winter counter-offensive (Operation Uranus) that ended with the encirclement of 6th Army in Stalingrad.

name: Magical Eyes - Red is for Anguish
shortDescription: Magical Eyes - Red is for Anguish is a thrilling mystery story revolving around a series of unfathomable incidents in a town.

name: Mainland
shortDescription: A text adventure game about a 19th century explorer who finds himself stranded and alone.

name: Ruler by Default
shortDescription: Ruler by Default is a fantasy/comedy/drama visual novel, played from the perspective of a 21 year old male who is inadvertently summoned to another dimension and subsequently crowned successor to an evil overlord after an unexpected twist of events.

name: SECTOR
shortDescription: SECTOR is a simple hardcore classic shooter game that you play the role of Dimitri, he and ​​another scientists made fail biological tests and the infected enemies took possesion of technology evolution. Survive at this severe place, fighting against creatures and solving problems, now you need to place the order.

name: Vernon's Legacy
shortDescription: Vernon's Legacy is an horror adventure with an enigmatic story that takes place nearly a century ago. You are playing as Robert, the new owner of Dunkenhof manor.

name: Lootfest
shortDescription: Powelful voxel editor, create a world with friends online.

name: InsanZ - Retro Survival Horror
shortDescription: InsanZ is a retro-survival-horror-game of the latest generation. Discover the crazy world of InsanZ, face the nasty creatures from hell and survive to bring back balance to the world. Fight with over 13 different weapons against hordes of monsters, explore the dire world of InsanZ, discover old paths and hidden secrets, use the terrain...

name: Vindicator: Uprising
shortDescription: Vindicator: Uprising is a platform shoot 'em up with pixel graphics and an epic orchestral soundtrack.

name: Helena The 3rd
shortDescription: Pilot a jumping tank through a maze of underground caverns and dungeons in search of new abilities you'll need to progress deeper into the levels. Each upgrade is hidden out of reach of your tank, and can only be obtained after exploring on foot.

name: Seduce Me the Otome
shortDescription: A romantic comedy visual novel centered around a girl named Mika Anderson, who gets entangled in the affairs of incubi.

name: Wish Project
shortDescription: Wish Project is a vertical shoot 'em up that features unique and challenging bullet patterns, 4 difficulties ranging from casual to hardcore, 8 unique playable characters, 6 stages, local co-op, unlockable characters and game modes, and an intuitive scoring system that encourages replay and mastery.

name: Egyptian Settlement Gold
shortDescription: Colonize unused lands and protect the whole empire from a devastating famine! An exciting and entertaining mixture of time-management and strategy along with many teeming characters is waiting for you.

name: Avenging Angel
shortDescription: Avenging Angel is a story-driven FPS/Adventure game set in a Steampunk world.

name: Dwarven Brawl Bros
shortDescription: Dwarven Brawl Bros is a local 2 to 6 player 2D fighting (brawling) game with a retroish feel. Play as a dwarf and kill your bros! Fast-paced brawling in all-vs-all and team settings with 31 weapons, 38 stages, 26 game modes!

name: Pixel Star
shortDescription: Endless arcade action takes a modern twist, creating a uniquely challenging open space shoot-em-up experience. From brutal bosses to black holes and beyond, countless hazards await discovery. How long can you survive?

name: FleetCOMM
shortDescription: FLEETCOMM is a tactical squadron combat game overflowing with hardcore maneuvers and space-borne gunplay.

name: Demon Hearts
shortDescription: Demon Hearts is a 2D platformer game that will leave you feeling blood thirsty for victory every time you play! Take the winged and dangerously swift Vampiress Snow through many challenging silhouette environments while withstanding the many divergent demons, evil forces, and bosses!

name: One Ship Two Ship Redshift Blueshift
shortDescription: Redshift Blueshift is a tournament-ready pong-like 2D shooter in which two pilots fight for glory in their variable paddle ships! Power up your shields, unleash a horde of drones and homing missiles on your opponent and keep the hyper-ball in play! Supports local multiplayer and single player vs AI. Gamepad strongly recommended.

name: Moot District
shortDescription: Build and defend! Make Moot District yours!

name: SUPERVERSE
shortDescription: SUPERVERSE is a fast-paced, action-packed space shooter that launches you into an ancient network of interconnected universes. Your mission: travel back through space-time and prevent the extinction of humanity.

name: b 2
shortDescription: b 2: online multiplayer an alien place you are the bee: fly where you like, play as you like

name: Angel Legion
shortDescription: Idle or play whenever and wherever you want. Customize the looking of your favorite Angels. Automatically accumulate resources all the time.

name: Jungle Town: Birthday quest
shortDescription: A colorful educational adventure for children ages 2–5. Join six friendly animals, solve simple puzzles, find hidden objects, and practice attention, fine motor skills, and everyday habits while preparing a birthday surprise for the baby elephant. Play offline, with no adult help required.

name: Ukrainian Soccer  ( any two points directed towards the net can score )
shortDescription: This game allows to create scoring opportunities from many angles simultaneously what makes for a dynamic and exciting play. Direct any two points from your team towards the opponent's net and score. First party to score wins. It also features three board designs with zoom.

name: Battle Teams 2
shortDescription: Battle Teams 2 is a fast-paced multiplayer tactical shooter with Asian aesthetics. PvP offers action-packed game modes set in a rigorously balanced competitive gameplay environment. Cooperative PvE gameplay throws you and your friends into wave after wave of merciless adversaries.

name: The Deadly Path
shortDescription: Aid the Deities of Dread in their quest for vengeance and pave the way for their ascension. Gather grim materials, construct defences and expand the underworld to appease the rage of the gods in The Deadly Path, a unique building management and roguelike strategy game.

name: Ominoflux
shortDescription: Ominoflux will test your brain in a most peculiar way.

name: Tempest Tower
shortDescription: Tempest Tower is an action packed tower defense platformer where you must brawl with incoming hordes of Creepers while herding the local critters to safety. Build, fight, upgrade, overcome.

name: Patchkins Party
shortDescription: Patchkins is a multiplayer racing game for 2 to 8 players where you build the course as you play. Each round, players draw and place objects like Platforms, Obstacles, and Specials, then race to the finish without dying.

name: Chronicle Archive - Japan
shortDescription: Explore history like never before in Chronicle Archive - Japan! Customize your avatar, solve puzzles, collect badges, and connect with players worldwide in this immersive multiplayer adventure.

name: AstroScaper
shortDescription: Colonize barren asteroids and transform them into thriving space colonies. Discover powerful building synergies, solve satisfying placement puzzles, and journey from one procedurally generated world to the next.

name: Frontier Force Vanguard
shortDescription: Frontier Force Vanguard is an open-world, turn-based RPG where you take on missions and build your reputation and supports the Empire expansion.

name: Sad Virus Foodland
shortDescription: Walking simulation and adventure game where player controls virus character in foodland. Mission to avoid obstacles and find beer bottle

name: Rat Run
shortDescription: Jump your way through endless obstacles and smash incoming enemies as a cheese-thirsty rat! Accelerate to the maximum speed and unlock all biomes and playable rodents!

name: Monkey Wave
shortDescription: Monkey Wave is a fast-paced action clicker where you defend your banana stash against waves of hostile apes. Click rapidly to defeat primates and epic bosses in solo, co-op, and PvP modes. Deploy strategic abilities and survive the chaos of the jungle.

name: Hello Anxiety
shortDescription: Hello Anxiety is a pixel art narrative puzzle RPG set in a surreal world shaped by mental health struggles. Navigate eerie bookstores, silent streets, and haunting memories as you explore the layers of anxiety and self-doubt in this emotional, story-driven experience.

name: Eyes Of The ElderWood
shortDescription: Eyes Of The ElderWood is a first-person adventure horror set in Kashubian folklore, emphasizing diverse locations, challenges, and enemies. Draw spells to solve puzzles and deal with foes, or fight using a revolver. Keep an eye on your sanity level to avoid descending into madness.

name: Dream about yoU
shortDescription: A dashing blond partner drops in from the sky, declaring they're taking responsibility for you—but they need a small favor.Find them in your dreams, wake them up, and crack the dream maze. Sci-fi comedy, adventure starts now!

name: One Tower Defense
shortDescription: One Tower Defense is a Roguelike Tower Defense game where you control a single tower. Gather resources, buy weapons and upgrades, and fight endless waves of enemies. Play in single-player mode or in multiplayer mode, where the last survivor wins.

name: Police Chief Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
shortDescription: Free introduction to the full Police Chief Simulator game takes you to Winston Springs Police Station! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

name: AxeSlinger
shortDescription: AxeSlinger is a fast, movement based roguelite FPS where you shred through enemy infested dimensions using guitar weapons. Fight hordes, rack up insane combos, unlock abilities, and battle colossal bosses as The AxeSlinger on your path to ultimate power!

name: Restitutor: Empire Restored
shortDescription: Restitutor is a historical incremental grand strategy game focused on statecraft, diplomacy, and calculated warfare. Strengthen your economy, research new technologies, form alliances, and outmaneuver rivals through high-level strategic decisions without micromanagement.

name: Arrow Flow
shortDescription: Welcome to Arrow Flow - a stylish, minimalist puzzle game where every decision requires care and thoughtful strategy. Use logic and spatial thinking to direct all the arrows to the exit and prevent them from crossing.

name: Martha's Dolls 2
shortDescription: The viral horror hit returns. Step into the haunting ruins of the Martha's House , where every shadow conceals a threat and the porcelain dolls aren't just watching , they're hunting you.

name: Novel Forger: Suicide Mr. Fury
shortDescription: Suicide Mr. Fury is a Meta-Otome adventure that deconstructs the absurdity of falling for someone who doesn’t exist. Navigate branching paths, meta-narratives, and a multiverse of madness with the overbearing CEO, Mr. Fury, between digital delusion and harsh reality.

name: Slot Theory
shortDescription: A roguelike tower defense where every draft permanently mutates your build. Stack modifiers, trigger massive Surge events, and watch your defenses evolve into unstable, compounding systems that fight in ways you didn’t design.

name: Clutch Legend: FPS Career Simulator
shortDescription: Build a Counter-Strike-inspired esports career from nobody to legend. Master weapons, develop your skills, negotiate contracts, hire staff, and play or simulate every match on your road to the Major.

name: Dawn of Horror
shortDescription: Dawn of Horror is a fast-paced, brutal cyberpunk Battle Royale set in the decaying urban sprawl of Cygnus City, 2221. Following the collapse of civilization into a digital Dark Age, scavengers fight over the remaining ruins. Drop in, gear up, hack the system, and be the last one breathing.

name: BUNKER: RED FLAG
shortDescription: A global catastrophe has struck the world. A small group of survivors is trapped in an isolated shelter with resources too scarce for everyone. Take your seat at the table, convince the others you deserve to stay. Lie, pressure, manipulate – and decide who gets thrown out!

name: KESU-JI
shortDescription: KESU-JI is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics. (Puzzle Mode、Action Mode 、Shooting Mode) You can aim for high scores on the online leaderboards in each mode and earn rewards. Enjoy a satisfying merging experience set in a chill, relaxing atmosphere!

name: Pocket Dinos
shortDescription: An incremental dino collection game where prehistoric stickers come to life. Hatch eggs, discover unique variants, build thriving habitats, and uncover powerful combinations to grow your fortune.

name: DEMON SIEGE
shortDescription: Stack ridiculous power-ups infinitely in this retro-inspired FPS Bullet Heaven. Build completely broken combinations as you go from a lowly demon hunter to an unstoppable demon-slaying GOD. Includes Story Mode with multiple endings and Endless Mode.

name: Castleborne Survivors
shortDescription: A survivors-like game with side-scrolling action combat. Slash, dodge, and mow down endless monsters in a gothic horror castle. Upgrade with every choice, snowball out of control, and survive until the very end.

name: Source aged like fine wine: ballad of jets
shortDescription: A short, visceral, and physics-heavy descent into a personal third place. Spawn objects, defy the mockery of the void, and reach the flag before the burnout wins. Spawn lightweight Jets entities who smell nice, even when the world feels like a burden for you. Just dunno, puzzle game.

name: Toll: The Ferryman's Ledger
shortDescription: You are Charon. You take the coins from the eyes of the dead — and one of them, someday, must be your own. A short incremental with a real ending: five rivers, a tribute owed to Hades, and a price on your own freedom. It ends. That is the whole point.

name: Token x Token x Clicker
shortDescription: Run a tiny 3D office of robot employees — the Grammis — and pick up the token embers they drop. Win contracts on the lottery reel, ride out overtime rushes, renovate your one-room startup into a corporate tower, and climb to #1 in the market cap rankings. 200+ collectibles. Fully local.

name: CapyCam
shortDescription: There's no fuss here. There's only golden light, rustling grass, and dozens of friendly faces. Look for capybaras in the thicket, but remember the most important rule of photography: to capture the perfect shot, sometimes you just need to lower the camera.

name: CrystalStack
shortDescription: Build the tallest crystal tower you can. CrystalStack is a 3D physics-based stacking game developed with Unreal Engine 5. Carefully place transparent crystal cubes, keep your balance, and beat your highest score before the tower collapses. Relaxing to play, challenging to master.
